title: Signed Multiplication

copy.studentInstructions: Multiply the numbers and check the signs. Tap the answer under the matching letter. Tap again to unmark. Complete the winning pattern, then call MATHO!
copy.roomIntro: Students join with a room code and a display name. Each gets a different board with a free center square. Factors are positive or negative integers with magnitudes from 1 to 15; zero is not included. Products grow in magnitude from M to O. Choose the winning pattern below.
copy.callerHeading: A little multiplication. A lot of MATHO.
copy.callerSubtitle: Multiply the numbers and check the signs. Find your answer. Call MATHO!
copy.joinIntro: Get the code from your teacher. Let’s multiply!
copy.footer: Multiply it out. Find your square.
copy.bankIntro: Factors are positive or negative integers with magnitudes from 1 to 15; zero is not included. Answer magnitudes by column: M 1–18; A 20–45; T 48–80; H 81–126; O 130–225. Each magnitude includes a positive and a negative answer. Changes save in this browser; start a new game to edit questions already called.

presentationSubtitle: Match the letter. Multiply and check the signs. Mark your answer.
